The emergence of recent proof-of-concept sources of insect DNA can potentially revolutionise insect monitoring. On pp. 531–544, Physilia Chua and colleagues highlight further investigations required for scalability and discuss four key areas of advancement for the integration of DNA-based insect monitoring into policymaking.
